title: Chimney dhuan dekhti nahi, bas garam resistor hai 🔥 #shorts
description:
Tadka ka dhuan uthte hi chimney khud on kaise hoti hai?
Chimney dhuan dekhti nahi, ek garam tin dioxide resistor use mehsoos karta hai.
🔥 MQ-2 ke andar heater SnO2 ko 200–500 °C pe rakhta hai
⚡ Dhuan aate hi resistance girta hai aur AO voltage badhta hai
🧠 Comparator chip limit se compare karke DO pin chalati hai
⏱️ Use se pehle 5–10 min warm-up zaroori hai
Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D ke liye, roz ek gadget kholke dekhenge!
#shorts #MQ2 #Arduino #GasSensor #Electronics #KitchenChimney #DIY #Hindi
